note: barPitchSets[i] is the set the scroll instrument may play during bar i+1. Both sets are chord tones + safe extensions, so nothing can clash. Transport.position tells you the bar; swap the set on the bar line.

totalityPing.name: B5
totalityPing.why: the dorian 6 - consonant over both chords but OUTSIDE both scroll sets, so it reads as arrival rather than as another scroll note

scrollRules.velocityCurve: inverse - a fast flick is QUIETER than a deliberate scroll
